import json,subprocess
s=json.load(open('/tmp/seqs.json'))
i=s['input'].upper(); o=s['output'].upper()
ins="TAGATTAGAAGAAGAATTAAGAAGAAGATTAACAGAAAG"
pos=215
def rc(x): return x.translate(str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA"))[::-1]
def tm(x):
    r=subprocess.run(["oligotm","-tp","1","-sc","1","-mv","50","-dv","2","-n","0.8","-d","500",x],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return float(r.stdout.strip())
best=None
for lf in range(15,46):
    f=i[pos:pos+lf]
    tf=tm(f)
    if not 58<=tf<=72: continue
    for lr in range(15,46):
        r=rc(i[pos-lr:pos])
        tr=tm(r)
        if not 58<=tr<=72: continue
        if abs(tf-tr)>5: continue
        # prefer ending in G/C and Tm ~ close
        score=(abs(tf-tr), -(f[-1] in 'GC')-(r[-1] in 'GC'), abs(tf-65)+abs(tr-65))
        if best is None or score<best[0]: best=(score,lf,lr,tf,tr,f,r)
print(best)
score,lf,lr,tf,tr,f,r=best
A=ins[:20]; B=ins[20:]
fw=B+f; rv=rc(A)+r
print(fw,len(fw),tf); print(rv,len(rv),tr)
open('primers.fasta','w').write(">forward_primer\n%s\n>reverse_primer\n%s\n"%(fw,rv))
# verify reconstruction
prod=fw+i[pos+lf:]+i[:pos-lr]  # linear product from fw start around plasmid to rv start
newplasmid=fw+i[pos+lf:]+i[:pos-lr]+rc(rv)[:0]  # careful
# simpler: expected output rotation
exp=i[:pos]+ins+i[pos:]
# built circular: prefix..pos-lr + revcomp(rv)=... let's assemble
built=i[:pos-lr]+ i[pos-lr:pos] + A + B + i[pos:]
print(built==exp, exp==o)
EOF
cat primers.fasta
